title: Products Configuration
description: Array of product definitions. Each product groups teams and optionally defines product-level dashboards and config overrides.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product (lowercase slug).

teams.description: List of team IDs that belong to this product.

contactemail.description: Contact email for the product owner.

cycleTimeSlowHours.description: Threshold in hours for marking a PR cycle time as slow.

cycleTimeCriticalHours.description: Threshold in hours for marking a PR cycle time as critical.

analyticsprompt.description: Custom prompt text appended to AI analytics requests.

repos.description: Product-level repo-to-team mapping that overrides the team-level source config.

id.description: Repo identifier (typically matches the repo name).

owner.description: GitHub org or GitLab group that owns the repo.

teams.description: Team IDs this repo is assigned to at the product level.

id.description: Dashboard identifier, unique within the parent entity.

type.description: Dashboard type key (e.g. prcycletime, issuecycletime, aicommitscanner).

title.description: Display title shown in the dashboard tab.

description.description: HTML-safe description shown below the dashboard title.

jiraproject.description: Jira project key (e.g. AAP) when the dashboard queries Jira data.

chaturl.description: URL of the AI chat assistant endpoint.

aianalyticsurl.description: URL of the endpoint that returns AI analytics tooltips.

diagrams.description: Ordered list of diagram widgets to render.

endpoint.description: URL of the endpoint that returns the diagram data.

span.description: Grid column span (1 = half width, 2 = full width).

title.description: Optional override title for this diagram widget.

aianalytics.description: Whether to fetch and show AI analytics tooltip for this diagram.

description.description: Optional description for this diagram widget (shown as tooltip or subtitle).

params.description: Extra workflow request parameters for this diagram (e.g. {"view": "criteria"}). Merged into the request body; standard parameters are never overridden.
